title: Documents
description: The files of the document library: upload them, describe them, choose who sees them, schedule and publish them.
newDescription: Saved as a draft first; readers find it in the library once it is published.
emptyHint: Add the first one; it stays a draft until you publish it.

description.label: Description
description.hint: Shown under the title in the library.

departments.label: Show to departments
departments.hint: Only members of the chosen departments see it; editors and admins always do. None chosen: everyone.

file.label: File
file.hint: PDF, Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx) or PowerPoint (.pptx) up to 20 MB, or a JPEG, PNG or WebP image up to 5 MB. The intranet checks what the file really is; files with macros, templates and slide shows are refused.
file.fileType: This file is not accepted. Upload a PDF, Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx) or PowerPoint (.pptx) file, or a JPEG, PNG or WebP image. Files with macros (.docm, .xlsm, .pptm), templates, slide shows and binary workbooks (.xlsb) are refused, also when they are renamed.
file.fileTooLarge: This file is too large: PDF and Office files may have up to 20 MB, images up to 5 MB.
file.invalid: This file cannot be attached (it is gone, or already belongs to another item). Choose it again.
